campaign_strategy: Move current customers from informed consideration to attendance without repeating the same product pitch. Every email defines New LUCI in one line so it works for a cold reader. Email 1 opens on putting programming power in the customer’s hands, uses the LUCI Upgrade Overview before registration, and uses the retention claim once to reassure customers that the same LUCI team remains behind them. Email 2 makes the preview concrete with three takeaways and clearly labeled next steps. Email 3 is registrant-only logistics. Email 4 restores the product view for non-attendees. The tone moves from invitational to concrete to logistical to accommodating, with one earned human line in each send.
open_questions: Who should be the named sender and signer: the customer’s usual LUCI contact, one campaign-wide customer lead, or Marketing?
Should email 2 use two visible links in one shared send, or should ActiveCampaign swap only the final CTA line by registration status?
Will [AGENDA LINK] point to a standalone agenda, a calendar event, or the registration confirmation page?
Confirm the final values for [WEBINAR DATE], [WEBINAR TIME], [WEBINAR PLATFORM], [REGISTRATION LINK], [JOIN LINK], [CALENDAR LINK], and [RECORDING LINK].
Should the recording link remain available indefinitely, or should the follow-up avoid implying a lasting archive?
